source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Steering, p.9-6

procedures.title: Steering wheel (Corvette telescoping): remove and install
steps: Removal: unplug the column harness at the wiring connector (see figure 13 in the manual).
Pry off the horn button cap.
Remove the 3 screws holding the horn contact to the spacer and hub.
Remove the 2 screws holding the lock screw to the lock knob; take out the lock screw, lock knob and spacer.
To replace only the wheel, remove the 6 screws holding the wheel to the hub and lift the wheel off; to replace the cancelling cam, skip this and go on to the next steps.
